title: RELATED reads a column of the one-side row for each many-side row
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Sales, "SalesKey", Sales[SalesKey], "Color", RELATED ( Product[Color] ) )

source.quote: RELATED works from the many-side of a relationship towards the one-side
source.supports: RELATED goes from the many side to the one side

source.quote: the function follows a chain of one or more many-to-one relationships to fetch the value from the specified column in the related table

derivation: ProductKey per Sales row: 1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 3, 1. Colors: 1 Bike Red, 2 Helmet Red, 3 Lock Blue. So Red, Red, Red, Blue, Red, Blue, Red.
